สำหรับสาว ๆ คนไหนที่เกลียดการออกกำลังกาย: For anyone who absolutely hates exercise or is so worn out from work that there's truly no time, today we have 5 tips for lazy people that help your body draw on stored fat and fire up its fat-burning furnace, without forcing yourself through gruelling workouts ever again.
5 เคล็ดลับเบิร์นไขมันเก่า ปลุกเตาเผาผลาญ: 5 tips to burn stored fat and fire up your metabolism, the lazy way
ปรับเปลี่ยนพฤติกรรมประจำวันเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ: Make small changes to your daily habits to stimulate your metabolism and draw on stored fat for energy on your own, as follows:
ดื่มน้ำเย็นจัด 1 แก้วทันที หลังตื่นนอน: Drink 1 glass of ice-cold water right after waking up
การดื่มน้ำเย็นจัดทันทีหลังตื่นนอน 1-2 แก: Drinking 1-2 glasses of ice-cold water right after waking up is an easy and highly effective way to stimulate the body's basal metabolism. It helps reduce blood viscosity after the body has gone without water all night, helping circulation work better and starting internal energy burning to bring the body's temperature back to a warm balance.
เพิ่มกิจกรรมทางกายในชีวิตประจำวัน (NEAT): Add more physical activity to your daily life (NEAT)
ในทางการแพทย์เรียกแนวคิดพฤติกรรมนี้ว่า N: In medicine, this behavioural concept is called NEAT (Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis), or the energy burned through daily activities. Research has found that small behavioural changes, such as taking the stairs instead of the lift, going for a walk after meals or doing housework continuously, can help burn more accumulated calories each day than going to the gym once a week.
การปรับเปลี่ยนสัดส่วนของสารอาหารในมื้อแร: Changing the proportions of nutrients in the first meal of the day has a major effect on your figure. Choose low-fat protein such as boiled eggs, chicken breast or unsweetened soy milk, because protein has a high Thermic Effect of Food (TEF), meaning the body must use more energy to digest and absorb protein than carbohydrates and fats. As a result, the body automatically burns more energy while digesting food.
การนอนหลับก่อนเวลาเที่ยงคืน มีบทบาทสำคัญ: Going to sleep before midnight plays an important role in the fat-breakdown process, because during deep sleep the body releases Growth Hormone, which helps repair cells and acts as a natural accelerator for breaking down stored fat. If you are sleep-deprived, sleep too little or stay up late, the body releases Cortisol, the stress hormone, instead, which disrupts metabolism and increases appetite.

สำหรับผู้ที่ปรับเปลี่ยนพฤติกรรมข้างต้นแล: For those who have already made the changes above but whose weight still won't budge, whose belly isn't shrinking and who feel uncomfortable from being overweight, the problem is often caused by Metabolic Slowdown. This can result from ageing, accumulated stress or incorrect dieting in the past, which has reduced the efficiency of the body's fat and energy metabolism.
